author: Unity
description:
In Unity 6, you can generate mesh levels of detail (LODs) on import by enabling Generate Mesh LODs in the import settings. Use LODs to improve performance by automatically swapping detailed meshes for simpler ones when they appear far from the camera.

Learn more in our documentation: https://on.unity.com/MeshLOD_Documentation

#GameDev #UnityTips #Unity3d #UnityLearn #MeshLODS
title: Generate mesh LODs on import
